name: Call of Water
summary: This ritualistic step marks the culmination of the shaman's ordeal at the Brazier of Everfount along the coast of Silverpine Forest. Having shattered the corrupt spirits threatening the spring with a burst of elemental radiance, the shaman stands before an apparition of pure water to receive its communion.

sections.title: A Burst of Cleansing Light
sections.body: Upon reciting the final incantation at the Brazier of Everfount, an explosion of light scours the area of surrounding corruption. The hissed protests of tainted water drops evaporating over elemental flame fade, leaving the immediate shore silent as malevolent minor spirits disperse.

sections.title: The Water's Gratitude
sections.body: In the wake of the spirits' destruction, a Minor Manifestation of Water materializes beside the brazier. Grateful for the ritual intervention, the spirit recognizes the growing burden placed upon the Horde's shamans: though the local taint has ebbed, life in the decaying lands of Silverpine continues to wane, requiring vigilance to preserve.

faq.q: What happens when the brazier ritual finishes?
faq.answer: Completing the incantation at the Brazier of Everfount releases an explosion of brilliant light. This destroys the surrounding corrupted spirits and purifies the immediate elemental flow.

faq.q: Who is the Minor Manifestation of Water?
faq.answer: It is a minor elemental entity of pure water that manifests after the corrupted elementals near the Brazier of Everfount are destroyed.

faq.q: What does the water spirit say about Silverpine?
faq.answer: The spirit expresses thanks to the shamans, noting that while this specific corruption has ebbed, life across the land continues to wane and requires constant stewardship to safeguard.

faq.q: Where does this ritual take place?
faq.answer: The ritual takes place at the Brazier of Everfount, situated along the coastline of Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why must shamans intervene in Silverpine?
faq.answer: As part of their elemental trials to earn the Water Totem, shamans must prove their commitment to balance by defending distant, embattled natural waters from blight and lingering corruption.

faq.q: What comes next in the trials?
faq.answer: After conferring with the Minor Manifestation of Water, the shaman receives elemental remains or guidance to complete their journey and forge their Water Totem.

angles.text: This communion directly tests a shaman's resolve to heal suffering waters far beyond their native homes, earning communion with the spirit of water itself.
The Horde's spiritual leaders must cleanse corrupted waterways even within Forsaken-controlled territories like Silverpine to maintain elemental harmony.
